intro: A thought in Italian or English. A Japanese sentence to build, without answers to choose from.
practiceIntro: Start with meaning. Write in Japanese, then see what works and what to revisit.
exerciseEmpty: Prepare a sentence to begin. No options needed: you write the answer.
scopeNote: A word missing from the lists is a dataset limitation, not proof of an error. Checks do not certify all grammar.
journalIntro: Observations from your attempts, grouped by grammar point. Mark what you have revisited.
statsNote: Grammar, vocabulary and register are AI averages. Coverage measures points attempted; independence attempts without examples; recall successful scheduled reviews. Zero can also mean no data.
openaiApiKey: Compatible endpoint key (leave blank to keep it)
openrouterApiKey: OpenRouter key (leave blank to keep it)
serverConfig: Saved keys are never returned to the browser. Values in .env remain the initial defaults.
mcpNote: Sync after configuring server commands in .env. Data remains in memory until restart.
footer: Active production · N5 only · no telemetry
noCertainErrors: No issues detected by the available checks.
cramNoSchedule: Cram does not change the SM-2 schedule.
noJournal: Grammar observations will appear after your first attempts.
starterData: Original exercises and attributed reference data subsets are included. See DATA_SOURCES.md for provenance and updates.
authentication_required: Sign in with the instance password.
invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS endpoint without credentials in the URL.
invalid_origin: Origin not allowed. Check APP_ORIGIN on the server.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
provider_failed: The provider could not complete the evaluation. Check the model, connection and JSON schema support.
provider_not_configured: Configure the provider key on the server.
invalid_provider_response: The provider returned an incomplete or invalid response. Try again.
no_exercises: No sentences match these filters, or no reviews are due.
mcp_disabled: Enable MCP in settings before syncing.
sync_weaknesses_first: Sync weaknesses in settings before targeted practice.
generated_outside_dataset: The model could not produce a sentence verifiable against the local N5 lists after the available retries. Try again or choose another category.
mcp_unavailable: One or more MCP servers are unavailable. Check server commands and tokens.
noWeaknesses: No weaknesses recognized in the MCP response.
not_found: Exercise not found. Prepare a new sentence.
Failed to fetch: Connection to the server was interrupted. Try again.
generation_requires_new: AI generation is available in free or targeted practice.
provider_rate_limited: The AI provider has reached its request limit. Wait and retry; also check your free quota on OpenRouter.
no_n5_weaknesses: The synced weaknesses contain no items compatible with the local N5 lists. Use free practice or update the data.
generated_wrong_language: The model did not use the requested English language, even after a second attempt. No exercise was saved. Try again.
generated_without_weakness: The model did not use the selected weakness after two attempts. Try targeted practice again.
